whenToUse: Form fields that pick one value from a short fixed list through the browser's own picker
Option lists sorted under group headings, with single options shown but locked
Fields at a smaller height, under a label and hint, or shown disabled or invalid

whenNotToUse.when: Option rows that carry icons, avatars, badges or descriptions in the open list
A long list the user narrows by typing before picking one
Choices nested more than one level deep, such as region, then country, then city

agentNotes: `className` on `NativeSelect` lands on its wrapper `div`; every other prop, such as `id`, `disabled` or `aria-invalid`, goes to the inner `select`
The first option's text never names the control; tie a `FieldLabel` to the `NativeSelect` `id` as `c-native-select-4` does, or pass an aria-label
No example passes a name to `NativeSelect`, so a native form submit leaves the choice out; add one inside your form
